fix.description: Root cause: daily_logs.water_intake_liters was NUMERIC(3,1) (0.1 L resolution); a 250 ml glass POSTed as 0.25 L rounded to 0.3 L in MySQL, and each refetch reseeded the tank from the rounded value, compounding ~+20%/day. Fix (backend, commit 09188ed + migration 20260714_003_water_ml_precision): widened water_intake_liters (daily_logs + daily_reports) and daily_reports.water_target_liters to NUMERIC(5,3) so 250/500/1000 ml store exactly. Migration is idempotent and already APPLIED on prod (verified: all 3 columns now (5,3)). End-to-end verified: added 4x250 ml on /nutrition -> prod stores Decimal('3.000') L exactly (was 2.000), no drift; yesterday 5 glasses = 2.500 L exact. No FE change needed (reseed Math.round(0.250*1000)=250).

judge.note: Numeric round-trip is the authoritative proof: 4x250ml glass adds -> prod daily_logs.water_intake_liters = 3.000 L exactly (no .X5 rounding/compounding). Column scale confirmed (5,3) on prod DB; migration idempotent and applied. Screenshot shows the /nutrition water card at a clean 3/5 L (60%).

issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Water tracker cumulative rounding drift: 250 ml "Glass" adds get inflated to ~300 ml on every synced tap and compound through the day.

ROOT CAUSE: DailyLog.water_intake_liters is Numeric(3,1) (0.1 L / 100 ml resolution), but the water tracker logs in ml. handleAddWater (src/pages/_components/nutrition/useNutritionData.tsx:116) adds the container ml (250/500/1000) and syncWaterToBackend (:94) POSTs liters = Math.round(ml)/1000, e.g. 0.25 L for a 250 ml glass. Backend _apply_daily_fields (app/routes/logging.py:488) stores Decimal(str(0.25)) into the scale-1 column, so MySQL rounds 0.25 -> 0.3 L. On POST success the mutation invalidates [daily-logs] (:106); the refetch reseeds waterMl from the ROUNDED backend value (:60-65 -> 300 ml). The next 250 ml add builds on 300, lands on another .X5 half-step, rounds up again -> compounding.

EXPECTED: log N ml, tracker shows N ml. ACTUAL: displayed intake inflates ~50 ml per 250 ml glass.

REPRO (taps spaced >600 ms apart = normal day-long sipping; each debounced POST + daily-logs refetch/reseed lands between taps):
1. Profile > Hydration: default container = Glass (250 ml).
2. /nutrition, tap "Add 250 ml", wait ~1s (debounced POST + refetch). Tank shows 300 ml, not 250.
3. Tap again + wait -> 600 (actual 500); again -> 900 (750); again -> 1200 (1000).
4. Net: 4 glasses = 1000 ml actual but 1200 ml displayed (+20%); goal-reached confetti fires ~1 glass (~250 ml) early.

NOTE: the SAME Numeric(3,1) root was worked around for the GOAL stepper in i-20260711-e23a (forced 500 ml steps so goals hit a .0/.5 L grid), but the daily-INTAKE side still logs 250 ml containers -> 0.25 L -> rounds. FIX: widen water_intake_liters to a ml-capable type (e.g. Numeric(5,3) or an integer-ml column) + migration; or snap FE cumulative ml to the 0.1 L grid before sync (loses per-glass precision but stops the compounding).

issues.description: [suggestion] Voice/text meal logging: speak or type what you ate in your own words and let the coach AI parse it into a food entry, instead of only manual fields or a photo. USER PROBLEM: Add Custom Meal (src/components/nutrition/CustomMealModal.tsx) only takes manual name/calories/macro fields today -- no free-text or voice path exists (grepped: no parse/describe/freeform handling in that modal, no SpeechRecognition usage anywhere in src). Snap-to-log (photo, i-20260706-sn4p) covers the visual case but not hands-busy moments (cooking, eating out, driving) or dishes that photograph poorly (mixed thali, soup, chai+snack). Competitors (MyFitnessPal voice log, Cal AI) ship this; NYUS has neither text-freeform nor voice entry. EVIDENCE: backend already has an LLM meal-estimation path for the photo flow (llm_service.py) -- the same prompt pattern (food description -> structured items+macros) can be reused for a transcript/typed string, so this is largely a UI + one new endpoint, not new AI infra. Also ties into the in-flight i18n directive: Hindi/Hinglish speech-to-text + parsing is a natural differentiator for the India-focused base. V1 SCOPE: in the Add Custom Meal sheet, add a "Describe it" text field (mic button using the Web Speech API on web / native STT on Capacitor where available, falling back to typed text) -> POST the transcript to a new /api/v1/nutrition/parse-meal-text endpoint -> LLM returns items+macros -> prefill the existing manual fields, editable before save (same edit-then-confirm pattern already used for photo logging). No new logging surfaces, no schema changes to DailyLog. EFFORT: ~1-2 days FE (mic capture + prefill wiring reusing existing food-item form) + ~0.5 day BE (one endpoint, reuse llm_service prompt scaffolding).
